title: Cosmic Spell Shop
description: A hooded figure in a purple robe stands in a vibrant, cosmic-painted room holding an open book with glowing colorful pages. An ornate white cabinet behind them displays a floating open spellbook dripping blue liquid, rolled scrolls, a glowing red orb, and hanging lanterns, while a red candle, potion bottles, and a 'Spell Shop' sign are visible in the foreground.
prompt: A hooded wizard in flowing purple robes stands inside a small room with walls and ceiling painted in swirling vibrant cosmic nebula patterns of purple, teal, red and gold. The wizard holds an open book with glowing multicolored pages. Behind him an ornate white cabinet with open doors reveals a levitating open spellbook dripping blue liquid, rolled scrolls, a glowing red orb, and ornate blue lanterns. A red candle burns on a table with potion bottles and runes. A red wooden sign reads 'Spell Shop'. Highly detailed fantasy illustration.
